cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

mechanism: A agrees to a photographer's requests while professionally redefining movement, distance and completeness so A can remain in the shade.
confusable: D143 narrows honesty; D167 affirmatively agrees and changes operating definitions to guarantee a preferred outcome.
comparison: Maintaining a pose and shade differs from avoiding manual effort during a move.
seedUse: Keep movement/zoom/portrait redefinitions and make the professional correct the photographer's actual requested measures.
